QuestInfo.name: Confidential Kaiser Report
QuestInfo.0: #p1101002# wants to talk to you. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# gave you the report from Kaiser's investigation. Give it a read.
QuestInfo.2: It was super confusing, but you made out some stuff about the Transcendents.

0.0: Good day, Angelic Buster. I am #p1101002#, chief tactician of the Cygnus Knights. Your associate Kaiser requested I speak with you. Do you have time?

yes.0: Kaiser's information on the Black Mage has been invaluable to our efforts. It is a shame that none of my own troops were able to provide this sort of insight.
yes.1: Take a look at this. It's why I came.

no.0: I was told your people were very polite...

1.0: The Black Mage, Rhinne, and the World Tree... If #p3000001# approved this, it must be true.

yes.0: But... it's kinda confusing. Maybe I better ask #p3000018#. He's super old...
